project: COSTRA - Cost-Based SQL Compiler & Query Optimizer
environment: current local runtime; measurements vary by machine and load
note: COSTRA's estimated cost values are synthetic model units and are not elapsed milliseconds. SQLite executes normalized SQL independently.

benchmarks.interpretation: Local end-to-end timing on a tiny in-memory fixture; not a general performance guarantee.
benchmarks.sql: SELECT d.name AS department, COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count, AVG(e.salary) AS average_salary FROM Employee e JOIN Department d ON e.dept_id = d.id JOIN Assignment a ON e.id = a.employee_id JOIN Project p ON a.project_id = p.id WHERE e.salary > 60000 AND p.budget > 100000 GROUP BY d.name HAVING AVG(e.salary) > 65000 ORDER BY AVG(e.salary) DESC LIMIT 5;

benchmarks.sql: SELECT name, salary FROM Employee WHERE salary > 80000 ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 3;
